additionalRules: Elf Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of an Elf Hero.
Dwarf Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of a Dwarf Hero.
Lake-town Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of a Lake-town Hero, or in the Warband of Gandalf the Grey or Bilbo Baggins.
Eagle Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of an Eagle Hero, or in the Warband of Radagast the Brown or Beorn.
The Battle of Five Armies may not include more Fledgeling Great Eagles than Great Eagles.

specialRules.name: We stand together
specialRules.text: Friendly models may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes if they are involved in a Combat with a friendly model that has a different racial Keyword to themselves.

units.name: Bard the Bowman
options: Exchange Great Bow for Armour and Horse - 20 points (this list's listed cost of 150 includes this exchange)

specialRules.name: Rapid Fire
specialRules.text: If Bard hits a target with his great bow, he may make another shooting attack with his great bow that targets a model within 3" of the initial target - it may even be the same target. If that second shot also hits, then Bard may Shoot again as described above. Bard can make a maximum of three shots per turn as a result of this special rule.

specialRules.name: Swift Shot
specialRules.text: Bard never suffers the -1 penalty To Hit for Moving and Shooting.

specialRules.name: The Black Arrow
specialRules.text: If he is upgraded to take the Windlance, then once per game Bard can fire the Black Arrow instead of shooting normally.

specialRules.name: Windlance Trained
specialRules.text: If Bard is upgraded to take a Windlance, then he counts as the only crew for the Siege Engine.

units.name: Dain Ironfoot, Lord of the Iron Hills
units.keywords: DWARF, IRON HILLS, HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Lord of the Iron Hills
specialRules.text: Friendly Iron Hills models within 12" of Dain automatically pass all Courage Tests they are required to take.

specialRules.name: Fiery Temper
specialRules.text: After Dain has killed an enemy model, then from that point onwards whenever Dain Moves, he must always Charge an enemy model if possible.

specialRules.name: Fearsome Charge
specialRules.text: If Dain Charges into Combat, then until the end of turn he counts as having the Terror special rule.

specialRules.name: Headbutt
specialRules.text: If Dain wins a Duel Roll but fails to slay every enemy model involved in the Combat, he may choose a single enemy model on a 25mm base involved in the Combat and roll a D6. On a 5+, the chosen model is immediately knocked Prone.

specialRules.name: Glamdring
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Glamdring.

specialRules.name: Narya
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Gandalf may re-roll any failed Fate Rolls.

units.name: Radagast the Brown
units.keywords: WIZARD, THORIN'S COMPANY, HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE
wargear: Great Eagle (mount, taken via the Exchange Staff for Great Eagle option, included in this list's listed cost)
options: Exchange Staff for Great Eagle - 55 points

specialRules.name: Sebastian
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. During a Combat, Radagast may roll an additional D6 in his Duel Roll, and may make an additional Strike if he wins the Combat.

specialRules.name: Master of Birds
specialRules.text: Radagast is always assumed to have Line of Sight to anywhere on the battlefield. Additionally, friendly Eagle models within 12" of Radagast gain the Resistant to Magic special rule.

units.name: Thorin Oakenshield, King Under the Mountain

specialRules.name: Orcrist
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. Orcrist has the Orcbane, Goblinbane and Uruk-haibane special rules. Additionally, the wielder of Orcrist has the Terror (Orc), Terror (Goblin) and Terror (Uruk-hai) special rules.

specialRules.name: Du Bekar
specialRules.text: Friendly Dwarf models treat Thorin as a banner.

specialRules.name: Ancestral Fury
specialRules.text: If Thorin Charges into Combat with the Infantry keyword, he may declare a free Heroic Combat in the Fight phase.

units.name: Thranduil, King of the Woodland Realm

specialRules.name: Bladelord
specialRules.text: If he is Outnumbered in a Combat, Thranduil may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes. If he has the Infantry keyword and is Outnumbered in a Combat, Thranduil may instead re-roll all failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Fury of the Elvenking
specialRules.text: If Thranduil is Outnumbered in a Combat, and successfully kills all enemy models that he was Engaged in Combat with, then in the following turn Thranduil may declare a Heroic Combat for free.

specialRules.name: "Do not talk to me of Dragon fire"
specialRules.text: At the beginning of his Activation, Thranduil can spend a Will Point to use this special rule, gaining the Terror special rule until end of turn and potentially forcing nearby enemies to test Courage or flee.

units.name: Balin the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Longbeard
specialRules.text: During the Priority Phase, after the roll for Priority has taken place, Balin can spend a Will Point to allow his controlling player to re-roll their roll for Priority.

specialRules.name: Skin-changer
specialRules.text: At the beginning of his Activation, Beorn can change his form from Man to Bear (Beorn the Bear: Mv 8", Fv 8, Sv 4+, S 8, D 8, A 3, W 3, C 3+, I 6+, Claws and teeth; Burly, Dominant (5), Fearless, Monstrous Charge, Resistant to Magic, Terror, Woodland Creature; Wounds/Might/Will/Fate remain the same between profiles). Beorn the Bear may not benefit from other models' Heroic Actions except from friendly Bear models, and only Beorning models may benefit from his Heroic Actions or Stand Fast while in Bear form; he must Charge if able while a Bear, and gains the Crushing Strength Brutal Power Attack.

units.name: Dwalin the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Grasper & Keeper
specialRules.text: These are Unique hand weapons. Additionally, a model gains a bonus of +1 to its Attacks characteristic when using Grasper & Keeper, and any To Wound Rolls of a natural 6 that are not prevented will deal 2 Wounds rather than 1.

specialRules.name: Weapon Master
specialRules.text: Dwalin is never considered Unarmed.

specialRules.name: The King's Axemen
specialRules.text: At the beginning of a Combat, so long as he is within 3" of Thorin, Dwalin can use this special rule for a Strength bonus or Defence penalty depending on the Duel Roll result.

units.name: Fili the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Combat Synergy
specialRules.text: At the start of any phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, if Kili and Fili are within 1" of each other, then they can swap places and not have it count as Moving. If they do this, then during the Fight phase of that turn they may re-roll a single D6 in the Duel roll.

units.name: Gwaihir
units.keywords: EAGLE, MISTY MOUNTAINS, HERO, INFANTRY, MONSTER, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: The Windlord
specialRules.text: Only Eagle and Wizard models may benefit from Gwaihir's Stand Fast or benefit from his Heroic Actions.

units.name: Kili the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Combat Synergy
specialRules.text: At the start of any Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, if Kili and Fili are within 1" of each other then they can swap places with each other - this does not count as Moving. If they have used this special rule during a turn, then during the Fight Phase of that turn they may each re-roll a single D6 when making a Duel Roll.

specialRules.name: Deadly Shot
specialRules.text: Legolas may make three shooting attacks during the Shoot Phase instead of one, using all the normal rules for shooting.

specialRules.name: Pinpoint Shot
specialRules.text: Instead of shooting normally, Legolas may make a single shooting attack against an enemy model Engaged in Combat with a friendly model (including himself), automatically hitting on a successful To Hit Roll.

units.name: Bifur the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Embedded Axe
specialRules.text: If Bifur wins a Duel Roll, then he may choose to headbutt an enemy model instead of making Strikes, dealing a Strength 4 hit; if it Wounds, from then on Bifur may take an Intelligence Test each Move Phase to declare a free Heroic Move.

units.name: Bilbo Baggins, Master Burglar
units.keywords: HOBBIT, THORIN'S COMPANY, HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Mithril Coat
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Mithril Armour. Additionally, the wearer may re-roll Fate Rolls of a 1.

specialRules.name: Sting
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Sting.

specialRules.name: It has not yet Awoken
specialRules.text: Bilbo ignores the Sauron's Will section of the rules for the One Ring. Furthermore, if Bilbo is the only model left on his controlling player's side, and is wearing the One Ring, he is not removed as a casualty as would usually be the case.

units.name: Bofur the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.text: Whenever a friendly Erebor Hero within 3" of Bofur is affected by an enemy special rule or Magical Power, they may roll a D6. On a 3+, the model will ignore its effects.

units.name: Bombur the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Lumbering
specialRules.text: Bombur may not declare Heroic Moves. Additionally, if Bombur rolls a natural 6 on a Jump, Climb, Leap or Swim Test, then he must re-roll the result.

specialRules.name: Raising Spirits
specialRules.text: Once per turn, during his Activation, Bombur can choose a friendly Erebor Hero model within 3" and roll a D6. On a 4+, the chosen model regains a Will Point spent earlier in the battle.

specialRules.name: Flail
specialRules.text: This is a hand-and-a-half weapon. Additionally, if the bearer wins a Duel Roll, then they can either make Strikes as normal or make a single Strike against each enemy model that was involved in the Combat.

units.name: Dori the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: A Good Sort
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of either Ori or Nori, Dori increases his Attacks to 3 and may re-roll any rolls of a 1 in his Duel rolls.

units.name: Gloin the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Axe Mastery
specialRules.text: If Gloin is outnumbered in a Combat, he increases his Attacks to 4 for the duration of the Combat.

specialRules.name: "Stand by our Men!"
specialRules.text: If Hilda-Bianca Charges into Combat, then during the ensuing Fight Phase, Hilda-Bianca and friendly Lake-town Warrior models within 3" of her gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

units.name: Iron Hills Captain
options: Exchange Shield and Spear for Mattock - Free

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, if a model wielding a Mattock wins a Duel Roll they may choose to try to knock down an enemy model instead of making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Elven Glaive
specialRules.text: This is an Elven spear. Additionally, a model armed with this weapon that is Engaged in Combat and is not being Supported may either gain a bonus of +1 Attacks for their Duel Roll, or +1 Attacks when making Strikes.

units.name: Nori the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Weapon Master
specialRules.text: Nori is never considered Unarmed.

specialRules.name: "Just a couple of keepsakes"
specialRules.text: Whilst Nori is carrying an Objective in Scenarios where this applies, he may re-roll all failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes. However, Nori may never pass an Objective Marker to a friendly model.

units.name: Oin the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Healing Herbs
specialRules.text: At any point during his Activation, Oin can choose a friendly model in base contact and roll a D6. On a 4+, the chosen model immediately regains a Wound lost earlier in the battle.

specialRules.name: Reading the Portents
specialRules.text: During the Fight Phase, Oin can spend a Will Point to allow a friendly Erebor model within 6" to re-roll a single dice during their Duel Roll.

specialRules.name: Hearing Trumpet
specialRules.text: Whenever an enemy Hero declares a Heroic Action within 6" of Oin, roll a D6. On a 5+, Oin may immediately declare the same Heroic Action for free; on a natural 1, Oin loses a Will Point or cannot Move that turn.

units.name: Ori the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Chronicler
specialRules.text: Whenever a friendly Thorin's Company/Erebor model within 6" and Line of Sight of Ori slays an enemy Hero or Monster, that model may immediately regain a single point of Might, Will or Fate spent earlier in the battle.

specialRules.name: Protect the Young
specialRules.text: Other friendly Erebor Hero models within 6" of Ori do not suffer the -1 penalty to their Duel roll for using a two-handed weapon.

specialRules.name: Archers, This Way!
specialRules.text: Friendly Lake-town models within 6" and Line of Sight of Percy may re-roll To Hit Rolls of a 1 when making Shooting Attacks.

specialRules.name: Blade Mistress
specialRules.text: If Tauriel is Outnumbered in a Combat, then before making her Duel Roll she gains an additional Attack for each model she is Engaged in Combat with after the first.

specialRules.name: Vengeful Fury
specialRules.text: If your Army also includes Kili, and he is removed as a casualty, then Tauriel's Strength is increased to 5 and her Defence reduced to 4 for the remainder of the battle.

specialRules.name: Dubious Counsel
specialRules.text: At the start of his Activation, Alfrid may choose a single other friendly Lake-town Hero model within 6" of him. Roll a D6 (modifiable by spending Will Points) and consult the table for the effect: 1) chosen Hero loses a Might Point, Alfrid gains one; 2) chosen Hero regains a spent Will Point; 3) chosen Hero re-rolls To Wound of a natural 1 this turn; 4) chosen Hero gains Fearless this turn; 5) chosen Hero gains +1 Fight Value this turn; 6) chosen Hero regains a spent Might Point.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader. They may, however, be included in another Hero model's warband as one of their followers.

specialRules.name: Bard's Family composition
specialRules.text: Bard's Family is made up of three models: Bain, Son of Bard (Mv 6", Fv 3, Sv 4+, S 3, D 3, A 1, W 2, C 6+, I 7+, Might 1, Will 3, Fate 2; Hand Weapon; Heroic Strike; Family Bond - whilst within 3" of either Sigrid or Tilda, Bain increases his Attacks to 2 and gains +1 to Courage Tests), Sigrid (Mv 6", Fv 2, Sv 4+, S 2, D 2, A 1, W 1, C 7+, I 7+, Might 0, Will 1, Fate 2; Unarmed; Fearful), and Tilda (Mv 6", Fv 1, Sv 4+, S 2, D 2, A 1, W 1, C 8+, I 7+, Might 0, Will 1, Fate 2; Unarmed; Fearful). May only be included alongside Bard the Bowman, as part of Bard's Warband. If any member is slain, Bard must always Charge an enemy model when able, prioritising the model that killed a family member. Da! Down here! - whilst within 6" of Sigrid or Tilda, Bard gains +1 Fight Value (and a re-roll on his Duel Roll if within 6" of both), and may declare a free Heroic Combat to join their Combat under the stated conditions.

units.name: Fledgeling Great Eagle
units.keywords: EAGLE | MISTY MOUNTAINS | WARRIOR, INFANTRY, MONSTER | 60MM

units.name: Great Eagle
units.keywords: EAGLE | MISTY MOUNTAINS | WARRIOR, INFANTRY, MONSTER | 60MM

units.name: Iron Hills Goat Rider
options: Exchange War Spear for Mattock - Free

specialRules.name: War Goat
specialRules.text: GOAT | MOUNT; Mv 8", Fv 2, Sv 6+, S 4, D 5, A 0, W 1, C 7+, I 7+; Mountain Dweller; Devastating Charge - when this model Charges against one or more 25mm models, roll a D6 for each; on a 5+ that model is knocked Prone.

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, if a model wielding a Mattock wins a Duel Roll they may choose to try to knock down an enemy model instead of making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Onwards Men of Esgaroth
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of a friendly Lake-town Hero who is Engaged in Combat, this model automatically passes any Courage Tests they are required to take for being part of a Broken Army.

specialRules.name: King's Knights
specialRules.text: Whilst they have the Cavalry keyword, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value and +1 to their Defence whilst within 6" of Thranduil.

specialRules.name: Elven Glaive
specialRules.text: This is an Elven spear. Additionally, a model armed with this weapon that is Engaged in Combat and is not being Supported may either gain a bonus of +1 Attacks for their Duel Roll, or +1 Attacks when making Strikes.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Battle of Five Armies army-list page. Full stat blocks, wargear, and special-rule text for Dwarf/Erebor/Iron Hills heroes and warriors from the Dwarven Holds faction page, Elves from the Elven Kingdoms faction page, Gandalf the Grey/Radagast the Brown/Gwaihir/Beorn from The Free Peoples faction page, and Bard/Lake-town/Dale entries from the Kingdoms of Men faction page. Note: the list page's stated cost for Bard the Bowman (150) is higher than his base cost on the faction page (130); this may already include the Exchange Great Bow for Armour and Horse option baked into the listed total.
